content: शप् A technical term used by Pāṇini for the conjugational sign अ inserted between the root and the terminations of the conjugational tenses in the first class of roots.
शप् {%ind.%} A particle and prefix implying assent or compliance.

शप् €1 €4 <ab>U.</ab> (शपति-ते, शप्यति-ते, शप्त) .²1 To curse, execrate; अशपद् भव मानुषीति ताम् <ls>R. 8. 80</ls>; सोऽभूत् परासुरथ भूमिपतिं शशाप (वृद्धः) <ls n="R.">9. 78</ls>, <ls n="R.">1. 77</ls>. .²2 To swear, take an oath, promise by oath, say on oath, (usually with <ab>dat.</ab> of the person to whom a promise <ab>&c.</ab> is made and <ab>instr.</ab> of the object by which it is made); भरतेनात्मना चाहं शपे ते मनुजाधिप . यथा नान्येन तुष्येयमृते रामविवासनात् .. <ls>Rām.</ls>; when used without an object it generally governs the <ab>instr.</ab> of the thing and <ab>dat.</ab> of the person by which or whom the oath is taken; सत्यं शपामि ते पादपङ्कजस्पर्शेन <ls>K.</ls>; <ls>Ghaṭ. 22</ls>; अशप्त निह्नुवानाऽसौ सीतायै स्मरमोहितः <ls>Bk. 8. 74</ls>; प्रेम जिज्ञासमानाभ्यस्ताभ्योऽशप्सत कामिनः <ls n="Bk.">8. 33</ls>; sometimes शप् governs a cognate accusative; सहस्रशोऽसौ शपथानशप्यत् <ls>Bk. 3. 32</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 110</ls>. .²3 To blame, scold, revile, abuse (with <ab>dat.</ab> or by itself); द्विषद्भपश्चा-शपंस्तथा <ls>Bk. 17. 4</ls>; प्रतिवाचमदत्त केशवः शपमानाय न चेदिभूभुजे <ls>Śi. 16. 25</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (शापयति-ते) .²1 To bind by an oath, conjure; शापितोऽसि गोब्राह्मणकाम्यया <ls>Mk. 3</ls>; शापितासि मम लवङ्गिकावलोकितयोश्च जीवितेन यदि वाचा न कथयसि <ls>Māl. 8</ls>. .²2 To cause any one (<ab>acc.</ab>) to swear by (<ab>instr.</ab>); सत्येन शापयेद्विप्रं क्षत्रियं वाहनायुधैः <ls>Ms. 8. 113</ls>.
